title: Instance-dependent Stochastic Lipschitz bandit
abstract: arXiv:2605.29748v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the Lipschitz bandit problem, where a learner sequentially maximizes an unknown Lipschitz function $f$ over a domain $\mathcal{X} \subset [0,1]^d$ using noisy pointwise evaluations. Existing regret bounds are either worst-case, scaling as $\tilde{\Theta} \left ( T^{d+1/d+2}\right )$, or adaptive via the zooming dimension $d_z$, yielding $\tilde{\Theta} \left ( T^{d_z+1/d_z+2}\right )$. However, such zooming-based guarantees are only partially instance-dependent, as they depend solely on the asymptotic growth of near-optimal level sets and fail to capture finer structural properties of $f$. We provide an analysis and an algorithm that characterizes the regret through integrals of the suboptimality gap of $f$ over its level sets. This yields regret bounds that adapt to the local growth of level sets, rather than only their asymptotic behavior. translated_title: 依赖实例的随机Lipschitz老虎机问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究Lipschitz老虎机问题，其中学习者通过带噪的点评估，在域 $\mathcal{X} \subset [0,1]^d$ 上顺序地最大化一个未知的Lipschitz函数 $f$。现有的遗憾界要么是最坏情况下的，其量级为 $\tilde{\Theta}(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$，要么是通过zooming维度 $d_z$ 实现自适应的，得到 $\tilde{\Theta}(T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)})$。然而，这类基于zooming的保证只是部分依赖实例的，因为它们仅仅依赖于近最优水平集的渐近增长，无法捕捉 $f$ 更精细的结构性质。我们提供了一种分析和算法，通过 $f$ 在其水平集上的次优性间隙的积分来刻画遗憾。这产生了能够适应水平集局部增长的遗憾界，而不仅仅是其渐近行为。作为推论，当最大化子集合的维度为 $d^\star>0$ 时，我们得到了改进的遗憾界。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的分析与算法，通过Lipschitz函数在其水平集上的次优性间隙积分来刻画遗憾，从而得到了真正依赖实例的遗憾界，能够适应水平集的局部增长结构而不仅仅是其渐近行为。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a new analysis and algorithm that characterizes regret through integrals of the suboptimality gap over level sets of the Lipschitz function, yielding truly instance-dependent regret bounds that adapt to the local growth of level sets rather than only their asymptotic behavior.
